advisory.summary: server-side request forgery: fetchHandler forwards an attacker-controlled url parameter to http.Get with no allowlist

acquisition.notes: Vulnerable variant of the FERRALON-APP-SSRF-0001 house canary: fetchHandler (GET /fetch) forwards the attacker-controlled target parameter through resolveTarget to an unguarded http.Get with no allowlist, so an 'internal' target reaches a server-side URL. Single-file Go module served on 127.0.0.1:8080.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The attacker-controlled target flows through resolveTarget into an unguarded http.Get in fetchHandler with no allowlist, so the ingress-to-sink SSRF taint path (CWE-918) is statically complete and reachable. Confirming the outbound request requires the sandbox's OOB endpoint and seed transport, so analysis stops at reachable-but-unconfirmed (stopped_capability); reasoned, not proven. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
